deals.name: Magnolia's On The Bay
deals.deal: Bay Bar happy hour Tue-Fri 2-5pm and Sat-Sun 12-5pm at the bar and Bay View Garden: featured martinis $10, house wine $5 off, call cocktails, mimosas, Bloody Marys and sangria $4 off, craft drafts $3 off. Bay bites include oysters $15.90/dozen, shrimp cocktail $11.90, and $10 off listed sushi rolls.

deals.name: Lock 'N Key Restaurant
deals.deal: Posted weekly specials Oct 5-11, 2026: lunch soup and short-rib cheddar sandwich half $19.90, kale and beet salad $18.90; dinner maple-bacon pork ribeye $24.90, Calabrian chili ravioli $24.90, seafood lasagna $34.90, sage-seared triggerfish $36.90. Order online for takeout.

deals.name: Englewood's On Dearborn
deals.deal: Advertised daily happy hour 4-6pm at the front bar (excluded on certain holidays): discounted well cocktails, draft beer, bottled beer, and wine. Site also posts dinner and drink specials.

deals.name: Calico Jack's
deals.deal: Site specials: happy hour Mon-Fri noon-5pm; happier hour Mon-Fri 5-7pm all beers and cocktails 2-for-1; Sunday noon-4pm draft beer and Bloody Mary specials; free pool all day Wednesday. Cash only.

deals.name: The Waverly
deals.deal: Standing everyday happy hour 11am-6pm on the Venice/Englewood wine-spot list (updated Aug 31, 2026): upstairs house wines $7 and downstairs house wines $5.

deals.name: Rumours Wine Bar
deals.deal: Happy hour Wed-Thu 3-6pm: $1 off 6 oz pours and $2 off 9 oz pours. Wine Flight Wednesday 5-close: four 3 oz wines $25. Thursday 5-close: selected bottle plus small charcuterie $35.

deals.name: San Marco
deals.deal: Happy hour 1:30-5:30pm, closed Mondays. Tuesday 1:30-9pm half off bottles of wine. Wednesday 1:30-9pm half off all drinks for ladies night.

shop.name: Publix
shop.deal: Current ad week of Oct 1-7, 2026 (some stores Sep 30-Oct 6): BOGO Campari tomatoes, Fresh Express chopped kits, kiwi berries, Pero mini sweet peppers, Publix pineapple chunks, Sweetango apples, Lantana hummus, Publix shredded cheese, and Tillamook cheese slices.
